shots.caption: `hunch tui` opens a flow so you can run it and see why it went where it did
Left: the flow as a tree. Right: the node you have selected.
`2` jumps to the test cases. `enter` loads one.
Its input: the message the flow has to decide on
`r` runs the flow. The model answers each question in turn.
Green is the path it took: needs a reply, wants a meeting, so reply
Each answer has a probability. Under the threshold it would go to unsure.
The test's expectations: ✓ means the model answered as expected
No reply needed, so it went straight to archive
The node also shows what the previous run answered
`v` shows only the steps that ran, in order
